title: Auto-detected issue: error.log
root_cause: A dependent service or infrastructure monitor did not respond before the configured timeout period. This can be caused by slow network connectivity, overloaded service instances, or temporary service downtime.
resolution:
- Verify the health-check endpoint and network connectivity.- Check the target service logs for slow responses or resource exhaustion.
- Increase the health-check timeout if the service legitimately needs more time to respond.
- Restart or scale the affected service if it is overloaded.
